source_title: UNESCO Nepal Youth Media Champions and MIL institutionalization

missing_stage: turnout ballot validity candidate choice misinformation resilience institutional trust and representation

source_title: World Bank Budalangi Western Kenya flood early warning
unit_or_scope: Budalangi flood plain rural households and local disaster institutions
stage: local-language warning and community preparedness operation
direct_observation: Daily bulletins from real-time prediction equipment were broadcast by Bulala FM in local language; 300 rechargeable radios distributed; 40-member group mapped hazards; report records no fatalities in a 2011 flood after early warning
missing_stage: household receipt equitable reach radio maintenance protective action causal mortality and later performance
evidence_status: high for operational pathway; medium for reported outcome; low for causal estimate
next_test: trace exposed households through warning receipt protective action and flood outcome with maintained system data
